name: Preview
display_title: Let gadgets watch a Google Calendar for event changes

head_commit.message:
Say that a refused Calendar channel renewal keeps the old channel until it expires

Unlike a first channel Google refuses, a refused renewal leaves notifications arriving on the old channel, so reads stay hourly until it expires rather than every two minutes. Also, for the record: the account tracking the first commit shares forgets an account's tracked: note before dropping its hooks rather than after, so if dropping them fails partway, the next alarm asks the account again at once instead of a day later.
